suggested_tests.name: test_load_settings_with_tomllib
suggested_tests.purpose: Verify that load_settings correctly parses a TOML file using tomllib.
suggested_tests.code:
import pytest
import os
from linkwatch.config import load_settings

def test_load_settings_with_tomllib(tmp_path):
    config_file = tmp_path / "sites.toml"
    content = 'title = "test-title"\noutput = "test.html"\n[[sites]]\nname = "site1"\nurl = "http://site1.com"'
    config_file.write_text(content, encoding="utf-8")
    
    settings = load_settings(str(config_file))
    assert settings.title == "test-title"
    assert settings.output == "test.html"
    assert len(settings.sites) == 1
    assert settings.sites[0].name == "site1"
    assert settings.sites[0].url == "http://site1.com"

compatibility_notes: The minimum supported Python version is increased from 3.10 to 3.11 to accommodate the use of 'tomllib'.
risks: If the project strictly requires support for Python 3.10, this migration will break it. However, the target version is 3.12.14.
